purpose: Rebuild the exact libtiff 4.7.2 source with the optional JBIG codec disabled; retain every other original external codec and the upstream Windows I/O implementation.

license_labels: spdx:GPL-3.0-or-later AND GPL-2.0-or-later AND LGPL-3.0-or-later AND LGPL-2.0-or-later

codec_inputs.scope: headers-and-import-libraries-only; runtime files remain original closure

configuration.linker_timestamp: --no-insert-timestamp at link; binutils strip uses the same fixed SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH 1786579200 for COFF timestamp and recomputes the image checksum

expected_output.distribution_note: The rebuilt library contains no JBIG implementation or libjbig import. Build tools are external build inputs only and are not part of the application payload; applicable MinGW/GCC runtime exceptions and startup-code notices remain inventoried separately.

verification_scope.upstream_ctest: All 18 configured upstream C API tests must pass.
verification_scope.native_api: All 206 original export names retained; expected imports frozen; direct codec query proves JBIG disabled.
verification_scope.runtime_probe: 38-file/29-provider selective Tesseract closure: version, English availability, synthetic PNG OCR to text/hOCR, invalid-image rejection and immutable input/runtime checks.
verification_scope.limits: No installer, Authenticode, full-worker isolation, performance, hardware or OCR-accuracy claim.
